proposals.evidence: DEDR 4395(a) attests Tamil peṇ woman, Kota peḍ wife, Tulu poṇjavu woman/boḍedi wife and Telugu peṇḍlāmu wife. Their differing kin and gender senses are explicit in the article; the explicitly borrowed Kota eṇ and Toda iṇ are not included.
